name: Isocetyl behenate
description: Isocetyl behenate (CAS 94247-28-6 ), also marketed under the trade name Pelemol ICB, is a branched-chain ester of behenic acid and isocetyl alcohol. It functions as an emollient, lubricant, and plasticizer across personal care and industrial formulations. This versatile chemical delivers skin-feel modification and surface conditioning without greasiness. In skincare and color cosmetics, it acts as a lightweight emollient that improves spreadability and skin feel in creams, lotions, and foundations. The product ensures a smooth application without leaving a heavy residue on the skin. Hair care formulators incorporate it into conditioners and styling products where it reduces friction and enhances manageability for the end user. In lubricant and metalworking applications, its ester structure provides film-forming lubricity suitable for specialty lubricant blends. This makes it an essential component for high-performance industrial manufacturing processes. Coatings and sealant formulators use it as a plasticizer and softener to improve flexibility and surface properties in finished films. It helps maintain the integrity of coatings while providing necessary physical characteristics. Isocetyl behenate is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid. It is available in cosmetic-grade quality, meeting the purity standards expected for personal care raw material sourcing and global distribution. Bulk supply is typically offered in drums or intermediate bulk containers for large-scale production.
